content.itineraries:
Day 1 — Arrival in Paro
Arrive at Paro airport and drive to the hotel. In the afternoon visit Rinpung Dzong and the National Museum, then walk the old market street.

Day 2 — Taktsang Monastery hike
Hike to Taktsang Monastery, the Tiger's Nest, set on a cliff above the Paro valley, then walk back down to the valley floor.
